theorem: W(3,3) Regular 4-Polytope Complete Substrate Package.  All SIX regular 4-polytopes -- 5-cell, 8-cell (tesseract), 16-cell, 24-cell, 120-cell, 600-cell -- have f-vector entries AND f-vector sums entirely in substrate-primitive form.  The four distinct sums (30, 80, 240, 2640) factor as (2 g_neg, 2 v, |E|, p_Ih * |E|), running across the X-scheme gauge multiplicity, the vertex count, the edge count, and the Ihara prime.  The multiplicative chain through the polytope cascade has ratios (2^q/q, q, p_Ih), telescoping to 2^q * p_Ih = 88 = g(K_{N_M}) at the conductor.  The 600-cell (120 vertices = v * q = 40 temporal triangles) is the substrate's complete time crystal, with f-vector sum p_Ih * |E| = 2640.  The 120-cell vertex count (120 = k * Phi_4) equals the Hodge boundary mode count, linking the polytope vertex set to the W(3,3) edge-complex Hodge decomposition.
